summary_1line: Rama asks his companions what rumors people spread about him and his family, inviting honest criticism to guide his future conduct.

image_candidates.scene_text: Rama sits among laughing companions in his palace hall, then turns seriously to Bhadra and asks what the people truly say about him.
Bhadra stands with folded palms before the seated king, respectfully preparing to reveal the rumors circulating in the city streets and markets.
